purpose: Teach: フリーズ/プロトタイプ/ゲラ/内野/地場/からくり/ペンネーム/中高生

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 画面フリーズが続くPCを交換しましょう
lines.en: Let's replace this PC—the screen freezing is becoming a real problem.
lines.style: Brisk, direct opening. Practical tone without ceremony. Steady pace moving toward solution. A quick nod to the problem, then forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プロトタイプの検証会議を設定します
lines.en: Got it. I'll set up the prototype review meeting.
lines.style: Attentive, efficient. Light agreement without elaboration. Picks up the task cleanly. Voice steady and supportive—not reluctant, just matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内報のゲラを来週までに仕上げましょう
lines.en: And let's get the company newsletter proofs finished by next week.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人を内野守備、つまり総務に配属します
lines.en: Understood. I'll assign the new hire to general affairs—think of it as infield defense, in a way.
lines.style: Light touch on the explanation, almost conversational. A small metaphor offered, not pushed. Steady voice tracking the decision. Professional but warm enough to include him in the reasoning.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 地場の伝統工芸とコラボしましょう
lines.en: Let's explore a collaboration with local traditional crafts.
lines.style: Encouraging, exploratory opening. Slightly elevated energy compared to the previous lines. Forward-leaning tone—this feels like an opportunity, not an obligation. Warm but still directed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。複雑なからくりは避けたシンプル設計にします
lines.en: Right. I'll design it to keep things simple—we'll avoid overcomplicating the mechanics.
lines.style: Reassuring confirmation. Attentive to the unspoken concern about complexity. Steady voice. The tone of someone who understands what makes a project work and is committing to that path.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 作家のペンネームでも署名できる契約を整えましょう
lines.en: We should draw up a contract that allows authors to sign with their pen names too.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful directive. A moment of consideration built into the delivery—this detail matters, even if it's not flashy. Calm conviction. Slight emphasis on the consideration for the author's preference.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。中高生向けプロモを企画します
lines.en: Absolutely. I'll put together a promotional plan aimed at middle and high school students.
lines.style: Energized close. A touch more forward momentum than earlier lines. Affirming, clean handoff. The tone of someone wrapping up a productive meeting and already moving to the next thing.
